Aug 9, 2020 [...] I've been using WISP since the beta release in March and I've been loving it since. As advertised, the setup is incredibly easy and quick. I've enjoyed the many features WISP has to offer from both a client and operator perspective. Thanks to WISP's geo redundancy is have yet to experience any slow speeds or degraded experiences. WISP offers great prices for the amount of features and support they provide. UI/UX is amazing, very clean and professional looking. WISP by far is leading the game panel industry when it comes to design. I've been really happy with everything so far, and would recommend using WISP instead of other panels. Not only is the software great, so is the community. The discord is full of plenty of members who are willing to help you out. The staff are nice and helpful.
